limitations: The two-coordinate absorbing-term collapse is not original: it is an immediate corollary of a public 2023 Kearnes–Kompatscher–Moorhead–Szendrei recovery claim. Burgin 1974 is close prior art. The retained originality claim is only the explicit locally finite ring/fixed-field classification, to the best of the inspected evidence.
provenance: Exact ring and fixed-field algebra specializations of the prior locally finite Schreier recovery principle.
